title: QuickCraft Utilities
description: QuickCraft Utilities is the mod you need to optimize your Minecraft experience, with essential features like Auto Smelt, Quick Sleep, and Auto Crop, all of which are configurable.
body:
Tired of the repetitive tasks in Minecraft? QuickCraft Utilities is a lightweight, configurable mod designed to streamline your gameplay experience. It adds three essential quality of life features that save time and make your survival world or server more efficient.

**Features:**

- **Auto Smelt**: Mine ores like iron, gold, and other materials, and they will automatically be smelted and dropped directly into your inventory. This feature eliminates the need for furnaces and saves valuable time.

- **Quick Sleep**: Skip the night instantly by sleeping in a bed, even on multiplayer servers. No more waiting for other players to be in their beds—your sleep will fast-forward to morning.

- **Auto Crop**: Break a fully grown crop, and this feature will automatically replant it, dropping the harvested items for you. It currently supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, and beetroots.

This mod is built with the Fabric API, ensuring high performance, low latency, and broad compatibility with other mods.

**Environment Information (Server & Client)**
> This mod is designed to be installed on the server, where all its gameplay logic is executed.
> 
> Server-Side Features: The Auto Smelt, Quick Sleep, and Auto Crop features all require server-side processing to function correctly.
> 
> Client-Side Compatibility: While the mod is not required for players (clients) to connect to a server, it is fully compatible with client-side installation.
